Methyl Alcohol

  • Formula: CH4O
  • Molecular weight: 32.0419
  • IUPAC Standard InChI: InChI=1S/CH4O/c1-2/h2H,1H3
  • IUPAC Standard InChIKey: OKKJLVBELUTLKV-UHFFFAOYSA-N
  • CAS Registry Number: 67-56-1
